title: Electric Service Agreement Reconnection Charges and Standard Reconnection Hours
content:
Field Services and Credit & Collections apply the following reconnection values for each Electric Service Agreement rate schedule.

## The three reconnection charges

- **Remote reconnection charge** — the charge when service is restored remotely through a remote-switch-capable meter.
- **Field reconnection charge for standard hours** — the charge when a field crew restores service during standard reconnection hours.
- **After-hours field reconnection charge** — the charge when the customer elects same-day field restoration outside standard reconnection hours.

## Charges by schedule

Columns: RS is Schedule RS Residential Standard Service, RT is Schedule RT Residential Time-of-Use Service, REV is Schedule REV Residential Electric Vehicle Time-of-Use Service, GS is Schedule GS Small General Service, GST is Schedule GST Small General Time-of-Use Service, GD is Schedule GD Medium General Demand Service and LP is Schedule LP Large Power Service.

| Term | RS | RT | REV | GS | GST | GD | LP |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Remote reconnection charge, USD | 10.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 |
| Field reconnection charge, standard hours, USD | 65.00 | 65.00 | 65.00 | 85.00 | 85.00 | 140.00 | 285.00 |
| Field reconnection charge, after-hours same-day, USD | 145.00 | 145.00 | 145.00 | 175.00 | 175.00 | 260.00 | 520.00 |
| Reconnection payment basis | past-due balance | past-due balance | past-due balance | whole account balance | whole account balance | whole account balance | whole account balance |

**Standard reconnection hours** — the clock window in which reconnection orders are worked at the standard charge — are 08:00-17:00 Monday-Friday except company holidays on every schedule.

**Reconnection payment basis** — the amount that must be paid before a disconnected account is reconnected without an arrangement or protection: the past-due balance on the residential schedules (RS, RT, REV) and the whole account balance on the business schedules (GS, GST, GD, LP).

## Reading across the schedule

| Schedule group | Remote | Field, standard hours | Field, after hours |
|---|---|---|---|
| RS, RT, REV | 10.00 | 65.00 | 145.00 |
| GS, GST | 10.00 | 85.00 | 175.00 |
| GD | 25.00 | 140.00 | 260.00 |
| LP | 25.00 | 285.00 | 520.00 |

All amounts are in USD.
